handoffs.message: Pantheon-owned OpenClaw session lifecycle implemented with durable file-backed store, idempotent create (X-Idempotency-Key), state machine pending/active/cancel_requested/canceled/failed/lost, operator-id audit trail on every transition, degraded upstream recovery (lost state preserves records), and lifecycle routes under /api/openclaw-adapter/lifecycle/. Broker/paper/live remain deferred. Verification: python3 -m pytest services/openclaw-gateway-adapter -q (61 passed). Commit: ab13ad0.

Session lifecycle implemented and ready for review. Durable file-backed store, idempotent create (X-Idempotency-Key), state machine pending/active/cancel_requested/canceled/failed/lost, operator-id audit trail on every transition, degraded upstream recovery (lost state preserves records). Broker/paper/live remain deferred. Verification: python3 -m pytest services/openclaw-gateway-adapter -q (61 passed). Commit: ab13ad0.
Session lifecycle ready for review (commit ab13ad0). 61 lifecycle tests pass.

Review changes requested: get_session upstream refresh can raise LIFECYCLE_INVALID_TRANSITION for active->canceled and cancel_requested->active; see .orchestrator/reviews/SVC-OPENCLAW-SESSION-LIFECYCLE-review-codex.md.

Addressed both review findings. Fix 1: added 'canceled' to _ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS['active'] so upstream_reported_canceled no longer raises LIFECYCLE_INVALID_TRANSITION for active sessions. Fix 2: in get_session(), guarded the active refresh with record.state != 'cancel_requested' so a cancel-in-flight read does not attempt the invalid cancel_requested->active transition. Added tests: test_get_active_session_upstream_reports_canceled_transitions_to_canceled and test_get_cancel_requested_upstream_still_active_preserves_local_state. Verification: python3.12 (with local site-packages) pytest services/openclaw-gateway-adapter -q -> 63 passed (was 61).
Review approved: owner follow-up fixed the read-time lifecycle transition blocker. python3.12 -m pytest services/openclaw-gateway-adapter -q -> 63 passed. Returning to Claude2 for closeout.
